title: Towards Sustainable Large Language Model Inference: A Systematic Literature Review
abstract: arXiv:2611.18570v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference is becoming a significant contributor to both operational cost and environmental impact in modern AI deployments. Energy consumption during inference depends on multiple factors across the pipeline, including input and output length, model design, system-level decisions, and hardware characteristics. This paper presents a systematic literature review (SLR) of energy-efficient and sustainable LLM inference. We analyze selected primary studies to identify techniques proposed to reduce energy consumption across different levels of the inference pipeline, including input, model, system, and hardware. We further examine the trade-offs between energy consumption, latency, and accuracy, highlighting inconsistencies in how these relationships are evaluated. In addition, we review the tools, datasets, and metrics used for energy measurement, covering both software-based and hardware-based approaches. This surv

translated_title: 迈向可持续的大语言模型推理：一项系统性文献综述
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）推理正日益成为现代AI部署中运营成本与环境影响的重要来源。推理过程中的能耗取决于推理流程中的多个因素，包括输入与输出长度、模型设计、系统级决策以及硬件特性。本文对节能且可持续的LLM推理进行了系统性文献综述（SLR）。我们通过分析所选取的原始研究，识别了在推理流程的不同层面（包括输入、模型、系统和硬件）提出的降低能耗的各项技术。我们进一步考察了能耗、延迟与准确性之间的权衡，并指出当前对这些关系的评估方式存在不一致之处。此外，我们综述了用于能耗测量的工具、数据集和指标，涵盖基于软件和基于硬件两类方法。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述，梳理了从输入、模型、系统到硬件各层面降低大语言模型推理能耗的技术，分析了能耗、延迟与准确性之间的权衡关系，并总结了用于能耗测量的工具、数据集与指标。
